* Return true if the target language matches the detected language. We consider * it a match if, for the precision requested or detected, it matches. This means: *

* target | detected | match? * zh | en | false * zh | zh | true * zh | zh-CN | true * zh-CN | zh | true * zh-CN | zh-TW | false * zh-CN | zh-cn | true (case-insensitive) * * @param language * @return
